name: Interlink
tagline: Sri Lanka's #1 AI-Powered Recruitment Management Platform
description: Interlink streamlines and automates the end-to-end hiring process for companies of all sizes. It connects companies, interviewers, and job seekers on a single platform with AI-driven tools to reduce manual effort and improve hiring quality.

user_roles.super_admin: Manages the entire platform — approves companies, monitors activity, manages subscriptions and system settings.
user_roles.company_admin: Registers a company, posts jobs, manages applications, creates interviewer accounts, and tracks the hiring pipeline.
user_roles.interviewer: Reviews assigned candidates, conducts interviews, submits feedback, and manages their availability schedule.
user_roles.candidate: Creates a profile, applies for jobs, tracks application status, schedules interviews, and receives AI-matched recommendations.

core_features.job_management: Company admins can create, edit, and manage job postings with details like employment type, category, experience level, vacancies, interview rounds, and application deadlines.
core_features.candidate_management: Candidates build profiles with skills, work preferences, education, and experience. The system tracks their full application history.
core_features.ai_cv_screening: AI automatically screens and ranks candidates based on CV content matched against job requirements, reducing manual review time.
core_features.ai_question_generation: AI generates pre-screening questions tailored to each job posting to help evaluate candidates before interviews.
core_features.interview_scheduling: Interviewers and candidates coordinate interview slots. The system supports online and onsite modes with meeting links.
core_features.feedback_and_scoring: Structured feedback forms are provided post-interview. Scores are aggregated to support data-driven hiring decisions.
core_features.shortlisting: Company admins can shortlist top candidates from the applicant pool for further evaluation.
core_features.notifications: Real-time notifications keep all users updated on application status changes, interview schedules, and platform activity.
core_features.support_tickets: All users can raise support tickets for issues. Admins can respond, update status, and close tickets.
core_features.activity_logs: Super admins have full visibility into platform activity — logins, approvals, moderation actions, and content changes.
core_features.chatbot: An AI assistant embedded in the platform to help users navigate features, understand their data, and get recruitment-related guidance.

subscription_tiers.overview: Interlink offers three subscription plans for companies. Higher tiers unlock greater limits for AI features, job postings, and interviewer accounts.

tier_1.name: Starter
tier_1.suitable_for: Small companies or those just beginning to use the platform.
tier_1.limits: Basic job posting limit, limited AI screening credits, limited interviewer accounts.

tier_2.name: Professional
tier_2.suitable_for: Growing companies with active hiring needs.
tier_2.limits: Higher job posting limit, more AI screening credits, more interviewer accounts than Starter.

tier_3.name: Enterprise
tier_3.suitable_for: Large companies with high-volume hiring and multiple departments.
tier_3.limits: Highest job posting limit, maximum AI screening credits, unlimited or high-cap interviewer accounts.

for_companies: Register your company and wait for super admin approval.
Once approved, log in and complete your company profile.
Create interviewer accounts for your hiring team.
Post job vacancies with detailed requirements.
Review AI-ranked candidates and shortlist the best fits.
Schedule interviews and collect structured feedback.
Track your full hiring pipeline from the dashboard.
for_candidates: Sign up and complete your profile with skills, experience, and preferences.
Browse and apply for jobs that match your background.
Track your application status in real time.
Attend scheduled interviews and check feedback outcomes.
Use the calendar to manage your interview schedule.
for_interviewers: Log in with the account created by your company admin.
Set your weekly availability so candidates can be scheduled.
Review your assigned interviews and candidate profiles.
Use AI-generated questions during the interview process.
Submit structured feedback and scores after each interview.

platform_rules.company_approval: All companies must be approved by a super admin before they can post jobs or access platform features.
platform_rules.suspension: Companies, users, and job postings can be suspended by super admins for policy violations. Suspended entities cannot perform platform actions until restored.
platform_rules.job_limits: The number of active job postings is determined by the company's subscription tier.
platform_rules.ai_limits: AI screening and question generation credits are allocated based on subscription tier and reset periodically.
platform_rules.support: Users experiencing issues should raise a support ticket. Super admins review and respond to all tickets.

technology.ai: OpenAI APIs for CV analysis, candidate ranking, and question generation
